notes.title: Version 1.7 is up!
notes.content:
Hey folks! I uploaded a new version that fix some issues when you are having an inestable frame rate. Now the whole movement is more stable.

I think I can improve it a little more even, so I'm going to check it a little longer just in case, so stay tuned for more updates!

And let me know if you see something wrong! Here or send me an email to info@nonsensearts.com

Thanks!

- Nico

notes.title: New Update! Version 1.6 is up, for both Windows and Mac!
notes.content:
Hey folks! Sorry for the delay!

Thanksfully, i'm finally home from that crazy week at GDC, so I was able to address all the issues that you have been reporting. 

- Weird clipping is removed completely
- Movement against "movable blocks" is cleaner (you are going to be stopped if your "future" movement ends with you trapped)
- Abnormal jumps fixed!
- And other couple minor bugs fixed

I hope most of you could had avoid those errors, but if you experienced some of them: i'm so sorry! I hope you could give ETHEREAL another try :)

Anyway... errors may still happen because nobody is perfect haha. If you see something weird, please, send me an email to info@nonsensearts.com with the details!

Thanks a lot!!

- Nico

notes.title: We won the Audience Award at IGF 2019!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33564999/558d7ca1316d41948d786164f6f25b6279aa3cbb.jpg[/img]

So yeah! That actually happened!

That was most of all because of the support of all of you, specially the latinamerican communities, so we are going to thank yet again in both languages: Thanks! and Muchas gracias!

We will continue to work on fixing errors and making the ETHEREAL experience as good as we can, and we also want to bring the game to every medium possible.. so, let's hope we get some good news in the near future!

Stay tuned!

- Nonsense Arts Team / Nico & Tomi

notes.title: New Update! (v 1.5) Only on Windows for the moment!
notes.content:
I made a very important fix on the last version but, as we are currently on San Francisco for GDC, I'm only able to update the Windows versions (because I don't have a Mac available here).

As soon as we come back from the conference we are going to continue working on this update and update all the versions!

Sorry for the trouble! :)

The fix should prevent those weird jumps the player made sometimes where the player touched movable blocks and a couple of other details with the control that I wasn't pretty happy with.

I'm going to continue working on this update to fix all the errors that you guys are reporting. Please, if you see anything else let us know here on the forums or send us an email to info@nonsensearts.com

Thanks a lot!

- Nico

notes.title: September 2018 Humble Monthy
notes.content:
Hey Folks! Remember, if you were a Humble Monthly subscriber on September 2018, you can get a Steam key for ETHEREAL on your monthly receipt page.

Another reason why you should check this game out! :)

And don't forget to review the game if you happen to play it!

Thanks :)

- Nico

notes.title: New Update! (v 1.4)
notes.content:
Hi! 

First of all thanks a lot to everyone playing ETHEREAL right now!

I've receive a couple of bug reports and I did my best to address most of them as fast as I could.

The new update should fix most of the issues regarding movement (getting stuck, jumping in places where you shouldn't be able to, and that kind of things)...

Please, let me now if you find another error. You can do it here on steam or sending me an email to info@nonsensearts.com

Thanks again! I hope you are enjoying the game so far!

- Nico

notes.content:
